title.narrative: STUDEM: Increasing youth ownership in youth organisations

description.narrative: The Current project aims to strengthen the democratic and youth-led functioning of four organisations in Moldova, that during an outreach project supported by NDF in 2022 have agreed to implement STUDEM principles on a test-basis. The four organisations already have received trainings about how to implement the Code of Ethics (ANNEX 1) and Articles of Association (ANNEX 2), have signed contracts and sent their action plans for 2023. This application seeks to implement the action plans with the local partners within the STUDEM framework with STUDEM and Silba as monitoring and consulting partner. More concretely, this means supporting the workings of the newly established youth-board of the organisations, and strengthening their democratic structures in the organisations, their gender-mainstreaming and sustainability. Further, the project aims to connect young people across the country to increase regional cooperation and experience exchange.
